asserted_content.engine_rendering: The Lot of Food: from the Sun to Mars. The Lot of Water: from the Moon to Venus. asserted_content.method_summary: for each named good, a lot is cast from the year-revolution's Ascendant; its placement in a domicile/exaltation/bound/triplicity ruled by a planet in good or poor condition (direct/retrograde, combust, angular, aspected by benefics or malefics) signals whether that good will be cheap or dear
